proposals.before: Soon he was removed and made Grand Master of Splendid Horses.
proposals.after: Soon he was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Horses.
proposals.reason: 除 means to appoint to office, not to remove; the literal English reverses the sense.

proposals.before: Wei was stationed at the Divine Martial Gate; his wife's cousin, a leader of the feathered guard, beat a straight officer at the palace gate, and Wei at once impeached him.
proposals.after: Wei was stationed at the Divine Martial Gate; his wife's junior paternal uncle (congshu), a leader of the feathered guard, beat a straight officer at the palace gate, and Wei at once impeached him.
proposals.reason: 從叔 is a junior paternal uncle of the collateral line, not a cousin.

proposals.before: Sheng and the other four were all killed at Heyin, exactly as she had foretold.
proposals.after: Sheng and the other three were all killed at Heyin, exactly as she had foretold.
proposals.reason: 昇等四人 means the four men including Sheng (Yuan Sheng and his three companions), not Sheng plus four others.

decisions.reason: In appointment idiom, 除 means to appoint (or transfer) to office; ‘removed and made’ reverses the sense of 尋除太僕卿, and ‘appointed’ restores it.
其妻從叔 is the wife's junior paternal uncle of the collateral line, not a cousin; the proposed kinship wording matches the Chinese.
昇等四人 counts four men in all including Sheng, not Sheng plus four; ‘the other three’ restores the correct total.
